title: Survey slide, user brings data
spec: User pastes their own survey data and a source. AI turns it into a slide. User checks the numbers and catches an error.

messages.content:
Turn this into one slide for Monday's team meeting.

Our student survey (n=312):
- 42% use AI tools daily for coursework
- 31% weekly
- 27% rarely or never
- Top use: summarising readings (58%), then coding help (34%)
- 61% worry about being accused of cheating

Also from the university's 2025 report: only 18% of courses have a written AI policy.

**Slide: How our students use AI (n=312)**

- 24% use AI daily, 31% weekly, 27% rarely or never
- Most common use: summarising readings (58%), then coding help (34%)
- 61% worry about being accused of cheating
- Only 18% of courses have a written AI policy (university report, 2025)

**Takeaway:** Use is widespread but guidance is missing; students are left to guess the rules.
The first number is wrong. It's 42% daily, not 24%. I checked against my spreadsheet.

Sorry about that, fixed:

- 42% use AI daily, 31% weekly, 27% rarely or never

Everything else is unchanged.
Good, everything else matches the sheet now.
Great, the slide is ready for Monday.
